versions.name: Cutter Scout Reservation
versions.summary: A Pacific Skyline Council scout reservation in the Santa Cruz Mountains above Boulder Creek that historically hosted resident summer camp; a wildfire destroyed much of its infrastructure and the property is under restoration, currently running no camp program.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Pacific Skyline Council camping and Cutter camp pages. The source labeled this Silicon Valley Monterey Bay Council, which is wrong: Cutter Scout Reservation is owned and operated by Pacific Skyline Council (BSA #031). It is closed for camp program and under restoration after the CZU Lightning Complex wildfire; the property is not sold, so operating_status is not_operating. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence and council verified against Pacific Skyline Council pages; council corrected from the source's SVMBC. Property exists but runs no program (fire-damaged, under restoration) -> not_operating. camp_type resident_camp reflects its historical primary use; program_types left empty since no program currently runs; features unsurveyed.
